newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Brewery firm's profits, up 17 pct to $17.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Brewery firm's profits, up 17 pct to $17.2 mln.

text.p: Brewery firm Brasseries du Maroc said on Thursday its profits rose 17 percent to 162.5 million dirhams ($17.2 million) in 1996 from 139.2 million the year before.
The company which published results in the economic newspaper La Nouvelle Tribune said the figures had been approved by a board meeting last week.
Turnover for 1996 stood at 1.12 billion dirhams from 925 million in 1995, up 9.5 percent.
The company controls 95 percent of Morocco's beer market. It also manufactures under licence Coca Cola and Heineken brands.
Last February, it purchased 80 percent of soft drinks company Societe Industrielle Marocaine (SIM) which represents more than 50,000 clients and 280 distribution vehicles.
